title: CEO Gift Card Request
scenario: An email appearing to be from the CEO asks an employee to buy gift cards urgently.

answers.A: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.B: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.C: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.
answers.D: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.

explanation: CEO Gift Card Request: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Executive urgency plus gift cards is a strong fraud signal.
